script: A bear just stood up, ten feet from you.
Don't. It's as fast as a racehorse,
and running tells it you're prey.
So stand tall, and talk to it,
It stood up because it's curious, not angry.
You don't. You hold your ground,
because bears often bluff, and stop at the last second.
